ramagundam-ntpc-oustees.conditions_add: The completion report says the credit and loan became effective after the government and NTPC signed a subsidiary loan agreement, and that NTPC was to sell the project's power in bulk to the state electricity boards under bulk supply contracts satisfactory to the Bank. The government was to ensure state governments undertook to buy at least 85% of the output. The report names no resettlement or land acquisition covenant; it records 4,116 hectares acquired, 2,279 families affected and 782 families resettled in colonies.

why.fincov: ensure state governments undertook to buy at least 85% of the output

farakka-ntpc-oustees.conditions_add: The completion report says the loan's conditions of effectiveness were signed bulk power supply contracts between NTPC and the state electricity boards plus a subsidiary loan agreement between the government and NTPC satisfactory to the Bank, and that the effectiveness deadline was extended four times before the loan became effective on 30 August 1985. Financial covenants required NTPC's rate of return to meet 7% through financial year 1990 and 9.5% from financial year 1991 through 1995. The report says resettlement and rehabilitation was not formally addressed at appraisal, and that the Bank's rehabilitation guidelines were agreed with NTPC only in 1993 under a later loan.

why.fincov: Financial covenants required NTPC's rate of return to meet 7% through financial year 1990

indonesia-regional-cities-transport.conditions_add: The completion report says cities were requested to appoint selected key staff as a condition of loan effectiveness. The loan agreement required an action plan, based on a review of urban transport planning and service arrangements, to be prepared and implemented, and required the cities to update five-year urban transport investment plans; the report records both as only partly complied with. It says land acquisition and resettlement were discussed at appraisal and confirmed during negotiations, that no special resettlement plan was prepared and no baseline surveys were conducted, and that families without title received much less than those with full title.

why.admin: required an action plan, based on a review of urban transport planning and service arrangements, to be prepared and implemented

uganda-forestry-kibale-evictions.conditions_add: The Bank audit says the Development Credit Agreement contained only the customary clause that the borrower would provide sufficient operating funds, which the audit calls inadequate. The audit says the project did not require a resettlement plan, and quotes an August 1986 Bank telex saying the Bank must assume nobody will be evicted as a result of our project; it adds that Bank policy made resettlement planning mandatory and that an encroachment study included in the project was never completed.

why.fincov: the customary clause that the borrower would provide sufficient operating funds

antananarivo-plain-enterprises.conditions_add: The Bank audit says the credit agreement set a timeline for creating the agency to manage the flood control works, and that the agency was not created until about five years after Board approval, later than the agreement's timeline. The audit does not say a resettlement plan was required; it says land acquisition for the drainage works and the resettlement of affected people caused early implementation delays.

why.admin: the credit agreement set a timeline for creating the agency to manage the flood control works

kaltim-prima-coal-dayak-basap.conditions_add: Inclusive Development International says the IFC's US$186 million equity investment in Raiffeisen Bank International was done with the condition that it be down-streamed to the bank's subsidiaries in Russia, Bosnia, Kosovo and Poland, and was recorded as a capital increase in each of them. It says the IFC contended that Axis Bank had to use the US$100 million of bond proceeds only for on-lending to projects within India, and that the IFC provided no evidence of this, while the bond offering circular says only that proceeds shall be used for enhancing long term resources for funding infrastructure and affordable housing. The report says Raiffeisen's 2016 coal policy was based on IFC's recommendation, not a condition of the investment.

why.fincov: the condition that it be down-streamed to the bank's subsidiaries in Russia, Bosnia, Kosovo and Poland

ibadan-flood-channel.conditions_add: Before the 2014 credit could take effect, the World Bank required the Oyo State government to adopt a project manual, set up a project unit and an Independent Advisory Group, sign performance contracts with state agencies, and have the Governor approve in writing that the state's share of project costs be deducted at source each year and paid into the project account (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, 2014).

why.admin: adopt a project manual, set up a project unit and an Independent Advisory Group
why.fincov: the state's share of project costs be deducted at source each year and paid into the project account

sources_add.title: Ibadan Urban Flood Management Project - Project Appraisal Document

giza-north-groundwater.conditions_add: The World Bank lent the 2010 money to Egypt, which passed it on to the state power company EEHC under a subsidiary loan agreement; signing that agreement was the condition for the loan to take effect, and dated covenants required a project unit by October 2010, a contract between EEHC and its subsidiary Cairo Electricity Production Company, a project manual and co-financing agreements by end-2011 (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, 2010). The appraisal document says the project 'does not have policy covenants' (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, 2010).

why.admin: dated covenants required a project unit by October 2010

sources_add.title: Egypt - Giza North Power Project - Project Appraisal Document

cambodia-resin-trees.conditions_add: The 2000 credit agreement required Cambodia to send each forest concession management plan prepared under the project to IDA for review and comments before approving it; its conditions for taking effect were administrative (accounts, project units, project account) (World Bank, Development Credit Agreement Cr. 3365-KH, 2000).

why.admin: required Cambodia to send each forest concession management plan prepared under the project to IDA for review and comments before approving it

sources_add.title: Conformed Copy - C3365 - Forest Concession Management and Control Pilot Project - Development Credit Agreement

manila-water-concessions.conditions_add: ICIJ reported that the Asian Development Bank 'required MWSS to reduce water losses as a condition for the release of loan money', without naming the loan or year. The IFC, which drafted the 1997 concession agreement under a contract that paid it at least $1 million if the bidding succeeded, did not make water-loss reduction a target for the private companies. The World Bank and ADB held $249 million of MWSS's $307 million in long-term loans in 1995 (ICIJ, Loaves, Fishes and Dirty Dishes).

why.admin: required MWSS to reduce water losses as a condition for the release of loan money

sources_add.title: Loaves, Fishes and Dirty Dishes: Manila's Privatized Water Can't Handle the Pressure

mangla-dam-mirpur.conditions_add: Under the 1960 Indus Basin Development Fund Agreement, Fund money could be spent only on goods and services for the agreed works, all goods had to be bought through international competition unless the World Bank as administrator agreed otherwise, and no money could pay for goods from countries that were not Bank members (except New Zealand and Switzerland) (Indus Basin Development Fund Agreement, 1960). The 1964 supplemental agreement directed the Fund's money first to the cost of goods for the dam on the Jhelum River, which is Mangla (Indus Basin Development Fund Supplemental Agreement, 1964).

why.fincov: Fund money could be spent only on goods and services for the agreed works

sources_add.title: Pakistan - Indus Basin Project: Loan 0266 - Development Fund Agreement (conformed)
Pakistan - Indus Basin Project: Credit 0060 - Development Fund Supplemental Agreement

saguling-dam.conditions_add: The 1981 Tenth Power Project loan (Loan 1950-IND) could take effect only once Indonesia signed a subsidiary agreement passing the money on to the power company PLN on the same terms, with the government bearing the exchange-rate risk. The project agreement required PLN to fund at least 30% of its capital spending from its own revenues from 1985/86, keep its debt-to-equity ratio at or below 60:40, and the government to pay its electricity bills by the 15th of each month (World Bank, President's Report P-2949-IND and Project Agreement, 1981). The Bank's report lists no resettlement covenant; it describes resettlement decrees already issued by local leaders.

why.fincov: fund at least 30% of its capital spending from its own revenues from 1985/86, keep its debt-to-equity ratio at or below 60:40

sources_add.title: Report and Recommendation of the President: Tenth Power Project (P-2949-IND)
Indonesia Tenth Power Project: Loan 1950 Project Agreement

sendou-bargny-coal.conditions_add: The African Development Bank's Independent Review Mechanism found that "key policy covenants were not included in the Credit of Agreement on environmental and social measures", and that no Resettlement Action Plan containing compensation measures and livelihood support was prepared before the project was approved (AfDB IRM third monitoring report, 2022).

kotopanjang-dam.conditions_add: JICA's ex-post evaluation says Japan's ODA loan was extended under "the Indonesian commitment to pay sufficient attention to social and environmental impacts", and that the environmental management plan (RKL) and environmental monitoring plan (RPL) were approved in 1989. The evaluation frames this as a commitment rather than a covenant and does not set out the terms of loan agreements IP-358 and IP-374 (JICA ex-post evaluation, 2004).

ramu-nickel-basamuk.conditions_add: AidData's record of the US$560 million China Eximbank facility, committed on 23 July 2008, lists a 10-year maturity, a US dollar portion at LIBOR (3.119 percent at the time) plus a 1.6 percent margin and a renminbi portion at about 4.7 percent, with repayment by 2017, eight years after the mine started. The record lists no collateral, guarantee or policy conditions, and states no requirement to use a Chinese contractor, although China Metallurgical Group was the EPC contractor (AidData, record 64520).

hambantota-port-zone-clashes.conditions_add: AidData's record of the US$306.7 million buyer's credit says China Eximbank lent to the Government of Sri Lanka, which on-lent the money to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority. The terms were six-month LIBOR plus a 0.9 percent margin, changed to a fixed 6.3 percent in an October 2008 restructuring, a 15-year maturity with a four-year grace period, a 0.3 percent management fee, a 0.3 percent commitment fee, a 6 percent Sinosure insurance premium payable in two equal instalments within two years of signing, and a 1 percent penalty rate on overdue amounts. Under the 2017 port concession, responsibility for repaying the loan was transferred from the Ports Authority to the General Treasury. The record does not record any collateral, sovereign guarantee or tied-procurement term (AidData, record 33256).

santo-antonio-dam-madeira.conditions_add: No conditions attached to Santander's own lending have been published; BankTrack records only that the project has been identified as an Equator Project. Renewable Energy World reports that BNDES approved 6.1 billion reais (US$2.5 billion) for Santo Antonio Energia, 46.6% of the project cost, and set requirements that will enable utility companies to provide affordable rates to consumers. The same report says the project includes social investments of 50 million reais (US$20.9 million), as suggested by BNDES.

sources_add.title: Brazil bank funds construction of 3,150-MW Santo Antonio

wilmar-sambas-riau.conditions_add: IFC rated its Wilmar trade-facility investments, including a partial guarantee of up to US$50 million signed in February 2007 for a crude palm oil purchase facility, as Category C, leaving the plantation supply chain out of its review; CAO found that as a result the applicable Performance Standards were not triggered (CAO, Audit Report, 2009; IFC, Summary of Proposed Investment, Wilmar WCap).

sources_add.title: CAO Audit of IFC's investments in Wilmar
Wilmar WCap: Summary of Proposed Investment
